interface.defaultPrompt: Make the attached photo sharp and high resolution, faithfully preserving the original.
interface.longDescription: Upload a blurry, grainy or low-resolution photo with PixelBoost active: the plugin automatically applies the Ultra-Premium 16K Professional Remaster & Enhancement prompt and returns a sharper, more detailed version. It preserves content, identity, composition, colors, lighting and background, and favors fidelity over invented detail. It uses the highest quality and resolution supported by the available image tool; the 16K reference in the prompt does not guarantee native 16K dimensions or the recovery of missing information.

name: pixel-boost
description: Turns blurry or low-resolution photos into sharp, high-resolution images while faithfully preserving the original, using ChatGPT's native image editing. A single skill, with no servers or external services.
